name: Szabadszállás (Hungary)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Szabadszállás: a crowned blue shield with a white lily and reeds on a green base, within a yellow frame and a green wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szabadszállás arms with crown, frame and wreath
